text: Completed typed RRG inference hardening. Dense fits now carry one CoefficientInference payload with scope, covariance, variance scale, residual df, and method provenance; contrasts, chunk merge, image maps, covariance artifacts, and writer sidecars honor event-only inferability. Shared-whitening RRG now provides fmrireg-parity conditional covariance and deterministic fixed-block residual bootstrap covariance; full-rank shared and voxelwise fallback remain event-only for inference. Added standalone R oracle generator and exact conditional/bootstrap fixtures. Compressed voxelwise-AR RRG remains typed unsupported and is split to bd-01KX50HA4TGKKWR1CC2G8HRY2D. Evidence: sbt modelJVM/test 16/16, fitJVM/test 134/134, modelJS/test 16/16, fitJS/test 128/128; R fixture generator exit 0 and matched checked-in values; scoped git diff --check clean; trailing-whitespace scan clean.
